children: Shares of Ethan Allen Interiors fell after the company reported a lower profit and falling revenue in the fiscal first quarter.
Shares were down 9.5% at $18.41 after-hours on Monday. The stock closed up 1.4% at $20.34, down 11% this year.
The interior design company reported a profit of $1.7 million, or 7 cents a share, compared with a profit of $10.5 million, or 41 cents a share, a year earlier.
Stripping out certain one-time items, adjusted earnings were 10 cents a share.
Revenue fell to $129.6 million from $147 million a year prior.

Last week, Ethan Allen said its shareholders had voted to give activist investor Doug Bergeron control over the company's board. The company is in the process of a search for a successor to Chief Executive Farooq Kathwari.
